name: LED Wall
description: The picture zooms into a giant LED screen of round glowing diodes on a dark panel; a refresh wave sweeps across it, each diode flicking with a bright pop as it switches to the second clip, then the diodes melt back into the plain picture. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cells
params.description: Number of diodes across the shorter side

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the glow bleeding from the diodes into the dark panel

params.name: flash
params.description: Brightness of the flash of each diode as it switches

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much the picture zooms in while it is a screen

params.name: triads
params.description: Each diode is made of red, green and blue sub-diodes

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the refresh wave sweeps across the screen (x right, y up)

params.name: panel
params.description: Color of the panel between the diodes
